ana: Heads-up — pricing migration experiment goes live next Tuesday (day-zero cutover). Need ops + billing to review invoice mapping and QA edge cases. Who can take ownership of cutover checks? :eyes:

sasha: I can run the cohort mapping QA and verify tag parity with billing export. Quick question — how are we treating legacy reserved customers on the day of the switch?

mike: We shouldn't touch their committed rate on day-zero. Plan: apply new price sheet only to new subscriptions/usage, keep legacy contract lines unchanged. Can we confirm the invoice generator respects contract_line_id?

leo: I'll add a canary rule in the metering pipeline to snapshot pre/post prices for a random 1% cohort. Will also emit a reconciliation delta metric. cc @billing-bot for an invoice preview run.

billing-bot: Automated preview: generated 12 sample invoices for cohort "dayzero_canary_1pct". No negative adjustments detected. Preview ID: pvw_20260301_42.

ana: Sorry, ignore my stray messages.

sasha: For transparency I'll paste the SQL I'm using to select cohorts — please review and call out any customers we must exclude (enterprise reserved, partner reseller credits, etc.):

```
-- cohort: dayzero_canary_1pct
WITH elig AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM customers
  WHERE created_at >= '2022-01-01'
    AND contract_tier != 'enterprise_reserved'
), random_sel AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM elig
  WHERE MD5(customer_id::text) < '0x' || LPAD(TO_HEX(FLOOR(0.01 * 2^32)), 8, '0')
)
SELECT customer_id FROM random_sel LIMIT 1000;
```

leo: That looks fine; replace the MD5 trick with built-in hash modulo if available in the warehouse to avoid hex conversions. Also add an exclusion for reseller_credit_flag = true.

mike: Billing side requests: please include `contract_line_id` and `billing_region` in the CSV export so we can verify no auto-proration triggers. Also add a column `applied_price_version` so devex can trace which price sheet applied.

ana (Finance Ops): I'll own the final pre-cutover checklist and sign-off. Tentative checklist items: run invoice preview, export customer mapping, run reconciliation script, verify invoice templates, set feature flag `pricing_v2_ab` to false by default, coordinate on-call rota. Assigning tasks: @sasha cohort QA, @leo metering canary, @mike billing verification, @ana final sign-off.

sasha: Got it — I'll post results in this thread by EOD Monday.

mike: Will run billing verification Tuesday morning and ping here.

leo: Canary dashboards: I'll create short-lived Grafana panel and share link when ready.

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: invoice preview expiry in 72h for pvw_20260301_42.

ana (Finance Ops): One last ask — legal flagged a small set of legacy customers with special overage clauses. I'll DM legal for final list and update cohort excludes.

ana: Thanks all — being conservative on day-zero reduces churn risk. :thumbsup:
